study.question: Does real historical-click placement retain predictive value over a count-matched shifted placement when both receive the identical per-history action-contrast radius, and does that effect depend on task-specific residual routing?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation from retained full-population single-seed receipts: r0048: real-minus-shift click-AUC gap task=0.0022137622, shared=0.0030892731, task-minus-shared interaction=-0.0008755109; r0049: real-minus-shift click-AUC gap task=0.0005221450, shared=0.0004329073, task-minus-shared interaction=0.0000892377. The gap shrinks and the routing interaction changes sign under radius crossing, so neither placement-only nor settled routing-interaction explanations are established. r0047 real/shift task AUCs0.6660062523/0.6637715210 are nearly retained by the r0048 fixed-axis direction collapse0.6659894136/0.6637756514. In contrast, the r0045 residual/complement trajectory reverses the preference (real0.6642468841, shift0.6660166195), and is retained as counterevidence against an operator-independent real-placement benefit. Early token-zero/context replacement r0024 task AUCs0.6411900073/0.6414296870 are below unchanged joint0.6667535475, but original action-derived masks remain, so these are not complete feedback erasures. r0034 item replacement0.6637250089 and r0036 stopped item replacement0.6636235974 underperform r0037 stopped observed match rows0.6661693800, supporting further consumer-specific investigation without settling capacity or optimization. Initial DIN0.6555440824 and unchanged joint0.6667535475 remain utility references; all new performance is unmeasured. A target-match/history-feedback overlap encoded by real historical-click placement supplies useful information in stopped match-action rows0/4 beyond scalar action contrast magnitude. Setting both placements to the same symmetric RMS of their centroid distances should retain a click-AUC placement advantage. Its task-minus-shared difference is a separate interaction hypothesis. Radius crossing in r0049 weakened the placement gap but did not remove it, so r0048/r0049 alone cannot separate radius assignment, scale and placement. The hypothesis concerns these consumers only, under official_offline visibility.

inherited_components: Full standalone r0049 source and initial DIN feature embedding, target/context fields, four prediction towers, unnormalized scorer and Dice state ownership.
Original 100-position masks, supplied historical task masks, uniform primary compression, auxiliary compression and all scorer populations.
Observed action pools and ordinal action summaries; original item coordinates and raw/scaled match coefficients, counts, gates and all five summary widths.
Blocked match-action consumer derivatives, blocked auxiliary scorer/item derivatives and live context derivatives.
Identical four-adapter residual bank construction, zero final-layer initialization, execution and task/shared selectors.
study.proposed_difference: Introduce summary_contrast_radius=symmetric_rms. Obtain both real-click and within-block count-preserving shifted action centroid contrasts from the same masked history. Compute R=norm(concat(delta_click,delta_shift))/sqrt(2), in canonical click-first FP32 order, and use the same real-click-derived whole-history mean M in both placements. Set centroids M+(g-p)R*u with the inherited fixed unit vector and actual placement proportion p. This preserves per-history mean and equalizes centroid multiset/energy across placement at a fixed parameter state; projected contrast energy is the average of the two inherited energies. Empty/one-group cases retain the inherited means, and zero radius stays zero. Only the two stopped match-summary action consumers use synthetic values. Four full-data cells cross placement with routing. Existing r0048 same-radius and r0049 crossed-radius cells supply the eight nearest source controls; they are not repetitions.
predictions: Primary D_task=AUC(pairrms_click_task)-AUC(pairrms_shift_task)>0; D_shared is separately reported, with I=D_task-D_shared testing routing interaction. No numerical significance is inferred from one host seed.

At a fixed state and masked history, both placement cells have identical canonical radius/mean and counts, equal synthetic centroid multiset, per-block sums and global projected energy up to certified floating-point error. They differ only in within-block assignment to permitted positions and subsequent inherited routing.

The new contrast energy equals the average of r0048/r0049 radius-source energies for the same input state. Shared/routed models have the same registered parameters and bank execution, although effective optimization differs. No improvement over the unchanged incumbent is assumed.
falsifiers: A zero or reversed real-placement gap at the common radius weakens the proposed placement explanation; a favorable single seed is preliminary and requires paired repetitions before a mechanism claim.
No repeatable difference of placement gaps between routing modes weakens the routing-interaction hypothesis even if placement helps.
Changed masks, padding dependence, target-action influence, scorer population/state, item/ordinal/pool paths or unintended gradient ownership invalidates isolation.
If measured effects disappear with finite-precision/capacity controls or paired repetition, retain optimization/numerical explanations; no success claim from the earlier source gains.
alternative_explanations: The symmetric radius still encodes personalized historical actions from both partitions; these are not action-free models, and they cannot estimate total historical-feedback utility.

Matching global projected energy does not match per-position correlation, downstream summary norms, activation geometry or effective optimization. Those placement-induced differences are part of the intervention and do not prove a causal behavioral process.
BF16 coefficient rounding can leak the common mean into nominally centered match summaries; host certification is required.
Task-specific selection versus mean of all adapters changes gradient sharing/effective capacity despite identical registered parameter counts and execution.
Many adaptive validation comparisons and one frozen training seed limit certainty; official_offline action timing and non-ad-specific auxiliary labels limit deployment interpretation.

The full task mentions source-best utility references beyond the imported joint best. No additional source-best artifact or admissible local ID is exposed in this phase; those comparisons cannot be invented or reconstructed from unrelated campaign memories. Retain only the available allowed controls and mark absent source-best comparisons unresolved for any later assessment.
